findings.claim: For a shared field, current UI guidance places new browser and native implementations in @repo/ui/components/web and @repo/ui/components/native, with matching names and props; styling reads from world recipes.

For API access, current guidance points to typed shared contracts/clients in @repo/core and Sanctuary API native oRPC v2 procedures on /api/v1; procedures require a domain/subdomain capability, catalog entry, and card. Client-side direct database, .rpc(), and realtime paths are frozen pending v1 API coverage.

The older workflow's references to packages/ui and packages/core, tRPC, Zustand as the API source of truth, fixed hex palette, and blanket shared-logic placement do not align with the current package map, API cutover, world-based UI recipes, and platform boundaries.
No implementation substrate, active API contracts, field component signatures, or runtime/canary evidence was supplied, so exact files, procedure, and implementation status cannot be established.
